Welcome to my personal webssite. 

I am a researcher at [Cinvestav Monterrey](https://www.cinvestav.mx/monterrey), where I direct the [Quantitative Physiology Lab](https://moises-santillan.github.io/LabSite). My work focuses on integrating mathematical modeling, computational approaches, and biological data to understand complex physiological systems.
